sentences.text: It depends on what clause 9.3 says; the documents do not state the text of clause 9.3, but for an individual loan for a non_business purpose with floating rate sanctioned on 10 February 2026, pre-payment charge is not permitted. [core=true]
The documents state that the loan was sanctioned on 10 February 2026. [core=false]
The documents also state that for all floating rate loans and advances, and for loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, an RE shall not levy pre-payment charges. [core=false]
The documents do not state the text of clause 9.3, so they do not state whether that clause matches the no-charge rule or says something else. [core=false]
